<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL comparison examples, expecting continuation of the second URL's structure.

The first URL example `?foo=1&flag=true&bar=2` sets a template showing query parameters with a specific `flag` parameter, implying the second URL will contrast with it (e.g., missing `foo`/`bar`).

Final token `?flag` is the beginning of a query string in the second URL example `https://example.com/?flag`, immediately requiring either `=value` or `&` continuation to complete the parameter, likely mirroring the first URL's `flag` placement but in a different position.
"
URL 1: `?foo=1&flag...`
URL 2: `https://example.com/?flag`" — expecting a value or additional parameter describing the same scenario.
</explanation>
